name: rea-bundle-vendor
description: Install root for the vendored REA MCP server closure. scripts/setup.mjs copies this pair into <root>/vendor/.npm-staging and runs `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, so provisioning resolves exactly the versions in package-lock.json. The `overrides` block is the audit fix: rea-agents pins zod exactly ("4.4.3"), which is inside GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (<4.6.6), and only an override can move an exact pin without editing the published tarball.
